ns2:section.sectionText: Lectures begin on Monday, 11 June, 2012 and Discussions begin on Tuesday, 12 June, 2012. Hourly examinations will be held on the following Wednesday evenings from 5:00-7:00pm: June 27, July 11, and July 25, 2012. Final exams are scheduled through Aug. 4, 2012. Students who enter the University Fall 2011 or later are responsible for additional course-based tuition of $300 unless they are already paying differetnial tuition during the term of course enrollment.
